faq.question: What is the cost of summer courses in Switzerland?
faq.answer: Course fees can range from about Rs 20,000 to Rs 4 lakh and above depending on the duration and subject. Additional costs may include accommodation, travel, meals and insurance. 3\. Yes, Indian students can apply for summer courses in Switzerland if they meet the eligibility, documentation and language requirements of the chosen program. 4\. faq.question: Do I require a visa to attend a summer course in Switzerland?
faq.answer: Visa and entry requirements will vary according to your nationality, length of your course and purpose of visit. Indian passport holders are recommended to check with the official Swiss authorities for the latest requirements before traveling.
